name: Tsutsumi Mimi
source:
A high-school student who spends her summer holiday indoors and organising regular broadcasts trying out random things to please her fans. Tsutsumi Mimi is an alias, it isn't her real name. She relies heavily on home delivery to get the products she highlights on her web shows.

During one broadcast, a fan requests she move the camera to show off the room she stays in. She complies, but it marks the start of her journey into sexual slavery by a group of sex-obsessed male fans...

[Spoiler] Depending on player actions, Mimi escapes the clutches of the group holding her with the help of her old fans and thanks them for their help by participating in an orgy with them. Otherwise she remains trapped as her loyal fans desert her and she is coerced into pornography production with no hope of escape. [/Spoiler]
